title: Public site visual layout — tablet-834 + mobile-390, every page, every element
objective: The same meticulous element-level inspection as pass-1, at the two small viewports, plus the small-screen-specific failure classes: wrap, clipping, stacking order, touch targets, sticky/fixed chrome, and the md-boundary band (tablet-834 sits between md=768 and lg=1024 — the least-tested band on this site).

method.same_as: pass-1 (screenshot review fan-out + live-browser verification + issue evidence)

rubric_per_page: everything in pass-1's rubric, re-applied at these widths
wrapping: headings and SKU strings wrap at word boundaries, no mid-token breaks, no overflow of long unbroken strings (compound SKUs like IP37SH-IP36TH-IP39LH are the stress case)
stacking: multi-column sections stack in a sensible reading order; no orphaned labels separated from their content

touch targets: every interactive element >= 24x24 CSS px (WCAG 2.5.8 floor the repo already enforces via plan8-mobile — measure anything that looks smaller; new regressions only, plan8-mobile's covered set is known-green)
fixed/sticky chrome: mobile menu, sticky RFQ bar, and any fixed element — do they cover content at rest or at max scroll? does the body padding compensate (the T2.9 class)?
horizontal overflow: document.scrollWidth <= viewport at every page and every accordion/menu state; the NB18 items-stretch class of bug lives here
tap affordance: hover-only affordances that leave mobile users without a cue (note as C/D, not A/B — the site is desktop-biased by audience)
form usability at 390: /contact field widths, error visibility, keyboard-type hints (inputmode/type attributes) — misstatements only, no redesign proposals
specific_attention: tablet-834: the md-to-lg band — product page (sidebar behavior), homepage band grid, industries grid, footer columns; anything that looks like a desktop layout crushed into 834px is a finding
mobile menu open state on every route (open it and screenshot — the crawler only captured closed state)
FAQ accordions open/closed at 390; chip scroller reachability (C41's pinned control)
the sticky RFQ bar at 390 on the two-datasheet product (T2.9's old overflow case) and on long product names
hero at 390: the desktop-only photo must NOT be requested (intercept requests; the record claims 0 — re-verify, do not re-derive)
exit_criteria: every screenshot in both folders reviewed (counts in ledger)
mobile-menu open-state sweep done across all 10 routes
